about: The order of a map's entries (docs/adr/0108, D2 and D5): the order their keys were first put, which a key put again keeps and a key removed and put again leaves, going last; a walk meets the entries in that order, which `order` and `values` record, and is of the map as it was when the loop began, so a walk that removes each key it meets meets every one. A map is stated as the array of its entries, each [key, value]. Expected values are derived from the document, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: 1 put again keeps its place, first
1 removed and put again goes last
each key the walk meets is removed, and the walk still meets every entry the map held when it began
an empty map is walked by no turn of the loop
